from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CitationRecord(BaseModel):
    """One paper's citation records to other papers in the provided collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    cites_from_collection: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers from the provided collection that this paper references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    citation_records: list[CitationRecord]
